nodes.label: sentinel-headroom compression pipeline
nodes.description: Multi-stage message compression pipeline that reduces LLM context window usage via alignment, content-type routing, intelligent dropping, cache optimization, and CCR system

nodes.label: CacheAligner
nodes.description: Extracts dates, paths, UUIDs, versions; replaces with placeholders; delta tracking across calls

nodes.label: ContentRouter
nodes.description: Classifies by content type (code/json/log/html/image/diff/search/text); routes to type-specific compression strategy

nodes.label: CacheOptimizer
nodes.description: Inserts provider-specific cache markers: Anthropic cache_control breakpoints, OpenAI prefix tokens, Google CachedContent eligibility

nodes.label: IntelligentContext
nodes.description: Scores messages by recency, error weight, tool dependencies; drops lowest-scored when over token budget

nodes.label: CCR (Compress-Cache-Retrieve)
nodes.description: LRU-evicting store with TTL expiry and BM25 search within cached entries; generates retrieval markers

nodes.label: CCR Tracker
nodes.description: Proactive context expansion: finds relevant cached content with query relevance scoring and retrieval pattern learning

nodes.label: Compress
nodes.description: Pipeline orchestrator that chains CacheAligner -> ContentRouter -> CacheOptimizer -> IntelligentContext -> CCR

nodes.label: Orchestrator
nodes.description: Routes messages to type-specific compressors; handles CCR integration and headroom_retrieve tool schema with optional BM25 query

nodes.label: headroom_retrieve tool
nodes.description: Tool schema for retrieving compressed content from CCR store with optional BM25 search

nodes.label: Sentinel AI Frontend
nodes.description: Web/Tauri desktop application for interacting with Sentinel AI backend via WebSocket JSON-RPC

nodes.label: WebSocket JSON-RPC Client
nodes.description: TypeScript client implementing JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol over WebSocket for server communication

nodes.label: ChatView UI
nodes.description: React component rendering conversation message list with message bubbles

nodes.label: sentinel-cli
nodes.description: Command-line interface that creates compression pipeline and registers headroom retrieval tool

nodes.label: sentinel-app-server
nodes.description: Backend server providing new_with_headroom and new_with_compressor initialization methods

nodes.label: sentinel-ai-exec
nodes.description: AI execution engine that registers HeadroomRetrieveTool in ToolRegistry

nodes.label: sentinel-ai-tui
nodes.description: Terminal UI application that registers HeadroomRetrieveTool in ToolRegistry

nodes.label: Ponytail lazy senior dev mode
nodes.description: Development philosophy emphasizing YAGNI, code reuse, stdlib/native features, and minimum viable solutions with deliberate trade-off marking

nodes.label: ponytail-audit skill
nodes.description: Scans entire repository for over-engineering; ranks findings by deletable lines: dead code, stdlib reinventions, unrequested abstractions

nodes.label: ponytail-debt skill
nodes.description: Harvests ponytail: shortcut comments into tracked debt ledger to prevent deferrals from rotting

nodes.label: ponytail-gain skill
nodes.description: Displays measured impact scoreboard: code reduction (80-94%), cost reduction (47-77%), speed gain (3-6x) from benchmark medians

nodes.label: ponytail-help skill
nodes.description: Quick reference card showing ponytail levels (lite/full/ultra), all skills, triggers, and configuration options

nodes.label: ponytail-review skill
nodes.description: Reviews diffs for over-engineering; identifies what to delete (dead code, stdlib reinventions, unrequested abstractions) with one-line findings

nodes.label: ponytail core skill
nodes.description: Main lazy senior dev mode for coding tasks: YAGNI-first problem-solving with stdlib/native prioritization and minimum viable implementation

nodes.label: Test CI workflow
nodes.description: GitHub Actions workflow for testing on push/PR: Node 22, Python 3.12, rule consistency checks, version checks

nodes.label: Publish CI workflow
nodes.description: GitHub Actions workflow for npm publishing via OIDC trusted publishing on version tags
